title: On Carrying the baskets up the whole hill
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：carry　|　正文 362 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 carry 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 the farmer ① carried the baskets up the whole hill twice over, and every child in the field said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three autumns on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the farmer ② carries the baskets up the whole hill year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ carry the baskets up the whole hill at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ carried the baskets up the whole hill before — a line in the almanac for September 1943 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Carrying the baskets up the whole hill twice over, the farmer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far fence, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ carry the mark for the rest of his life year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Carry the mark for the rest of his life at once and never mention it again.

By 1956 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the almanac, and a new child from the next field ⑧ carries the mark for the rest of his life twice over every autumn without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the fence, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ carried the baskets up the whole hill again when nobody else would.

⑩ To carry the baskets up the whole hill, my mother said in 1961, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the field remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the field forgets, somebody carries the baskets up the whole hill year after year again and somebody must carry the baskets up the whole hill twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 搬运（一般过去式 carried the baskets up the whole hill：1949 年农人头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 搬运（一般现在 carries the baskets up the whole hill：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 搬运（不定式 to carry the baskets up the whole hill：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 搬运（过去完成时 had carried the baskets up the whole hill：1943 年九月的农事历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 搬运（动名词 carrying the baskets up the whole hill 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 带着（carry the mark for the rest of his life：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去带着那道疤一直带到老）
G. v. 带着（carry the mark for the rest of his life：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 搬运（后段两处：新来的孩子照例 carries the mark for the rest of his life，而母亲又一次 carried the baskets up the whole hill）

carry 意为“搬运”，自那以后农人年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 carries。

carry 意为“搬运”，新来的孩子每个秋天都照例带着那道疤一直带到老，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 carries。
carry 意为“搬运”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍搬运把那些篮子背上整座山头，用一般过去式 carried 叙述。
carry 意为“搬运”，结尾那句是母亲 1961 年的话：要搬运把那些篮子背上整座山头，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和田垄记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1949 年，农人来回两遍搬运把那些篮子背上整座山头；田垄里每一个孩子都说这是头一回。（carried the baskets up the whole hill）
多年以后，农人仍年年地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（carries the baskets up the whole hill）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯搬运把那些篮子背上整座山头这件事本身。（to carry the baskets up the whole hill）
早在 1943 年就有人搬运把那些篮子背上整座山头，九月那天农事历上的一行字就是证据。（had carried the baskets up the whole hill）
农人说过，来回两遍搬运把那些篮子背上整座山头这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（carrying the baskets up the whole hill 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻带着那道疤一直带到老，以后再也不要提起。（carry the mark for the rest of his life，祈使句）
answers: In 1949 the farmer carried the baskets up the whole hill twice over, and every child in the field said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three autumns on, the farmer still carries the baskets up the whole hill year after year without being asked.
My mother said later that to carry the baskets up the whole hill at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had carried the baskets up the whole hill long before 1956, and the line in the almanac for September proves it.
Carrying the baskets up the whole hill twice over, the farmer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Carry the mark for the rest of his life at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 carry 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1949 the farmer carried the baskets up the whole hill twice over, and nobody in the field forgot it.
Even now the farmer carries the baskets up the whole hill year after year whenever the field asks.
Carrying the baskets up the whole hill twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever carry the mark for the rest of his life year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new child from the next field carries the mark for the rest of his life twice over every autumn, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother carried the baskets up the whole hill again, and the field remembered that half.
